facts.text: SUNY Old Westbury was created after Governor Nelson Rockefeller called in 1965 for an experimental college, and today serves 5,000 students on Long Island.

sources.title: About Us - SUNY Old Westbury
sources.quote: The SUNY Old Westbury story extends from then-Governor Nelson Rockefeller's call in 1965 for an experimental college to today's campus where 5,000 students gather to study, work and serve.
